278188213.description:
Vintage Boy Scout Rocks Minerals Kit + Scholastic Rocks Set + Scott Scientific
This listing includes three educational geology sets: 1) Vintage Boy Scout Rocks and Minerals Kit with 60 selected specimens, original box approx. 13 x 9.5 inches, and an interior reference guide; 2) Scholastic Amazing Rocks & Minerals kit for ages 5+, containing 12 labeled stones and a magnifying glass in a colorful display box; 3) Scott Scientific Inc. Fossils and Artifacts set with individually labeled fossil and mineral specimens including dinosaur bone, petrified wood, shark's tooth, and various rocks, housed in a compartmentalized box. All sets are in used vintage and modern condition, showing visible box wear, tape repairs, and some aging. Contents appear complete and well-organized. Suitable for collectors, educators, or enthusiasts interested in geology, paleontology, or earth science.
